review: Request: at round 18 Kai (health 100, satiety 79.8, energy 40, no tools) asked for a learnable physical method that opens an owned hard-shelled nut and separates any accessible kernel from the shell, owning item-16-kai-161, 0.9 unit of hazelnut from start-1-nuts, after a probe press at intensity 0.3 had held and consumed 0.1. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) a general operation to crack and separate a hard casing, parameterized by an owned target, a quantity, an owned striker, a support reference and a mode crack, separate or crack-and-separate, by controlled supported impacts with a real owned hard blunt striker on a stable support and manual removal of accessible loose casing, in blocks of at most 0.1 unit (1 energy per cracking round, 0.5 per separation round only for an opened block; at most 1 unit per job, so 0.9 unit is at most 18 rounds and 13.5 energy), with fracture from actual casing resistance, contact and impact bounds, declared deterministic wear, conserved products, preserved spoilage, no edibility shortcut and the stated pause, resume, cancel and death rules. Reuse: the existing ex20 open-and-separate-sample@1 and ex22 prepare-shelled-food@1 reserve whole units only and both refuse a 0.9 stack before any cost (ex20: holds less than one whole unit; ex22: holds 0.9; 1 whole unit(s) were selected), which the new test confirms in their own worlds; so a new module imports the ex20 HAZELNUT_COMPOSITION (kernel 0.4, shell 0.6 of the mass, kernel loose in the cavity) and SAMPLE_OPENING_LAWS (the ex17/ex19/ex20 transmission law strength x (1 - flexibility) and the deterioration classes), the ex19 shared piece, contact, ground and light checks, the collective-work reservation and payment helpers and openRemember, and re-applies the open-hardness-physics scratchStroke contact rules and its 0.0001 kg dust quantum; no existing package file was edited, and the test asserts the sha256 of every one of the 115 previously registered packages (as one digest, and open-and-separate-sample@1, prepare-shelled-food@1, shell-compression-opening@1 and rooted-plant-watering@1 individually), the rooted-plant-watering@1 hash having been added to the scratch hash file before this change. Implemented (full mechanism, not a first release): crack-and-separate-casing@1 (ability crack-and-separate-casing, handler long.crack-and-separate-casing, equivalence material:hard-casing:supported-impact-block-crack-separate:1, learning 3 with no study energy, 3,357 code units, appended last to the package list) with modes crack, separate and crack-and-separate, plus resume, pause and cancel (one round, no energy) and quoteOnly, which reports quantity, blocks, striker condition (mass, recorded contacts, soundness), the exact phase count, maximum energy and wear bounds at no cost and reserves nothing. A start validates everything before any charge: a living worker; target an own unreserved, untreated, unspoiled item of a material with a represented casing (closed for the crack modes, cracked unseparated for separate); quantity in exact tenths from 0.1 to 1 (default all, up to 1) and not above the item; for the crack modes a striker that is an own whole, rigid (hardness at least 1), sound inedible piece and a support that is a solid, unreserved, inedible, rigid object within reach and in view, not a plant or animal, or another own sound piece on firm ground, all three different; and energy for the first phase. The selected quantity is reserved in one work record (workId) with the striker and support pinned; ownership, reach, soundness, energy and the reserved material are rechecked before every phase, and a failed recheck refuses an explicit resume at no cost or pauses a continuing round before any charge. Cracking: each round takes one 0.1 block and applies one bounded impact whose load is the lower of striker and support strength x (1 - flexibility) (hidden, never reported); at or below the casing strength (hardness / 10, 0.4 for hazelnut) the casing is unchanged, a real paid result that ends the job and returns the material as it was (identical further impacts with the pinned gear could not change it; a reattempt is new paid work); above it the block gains damage (load - strength) / strength from its current state: below 1 it stays closed and damaged in a reserved closed item carrying its damage, at 1 it fractures open into reserved cracked unseparated material. A stone striker on the rock passes 0.8 and fractures a block in one impact; a branch passes 0.24 and leaves it unchanged; oak passes 0.56 and adds 0.4 per job, so a third job fractures it. Separation: one hand round per opened block (no striker, support, reach of the rock or light needed) takes it apart into exactly 0.1 loose kernel and 0.1 casing fragments; in crack-and-separate a block that does not open incurs no separation phase. Products are exact tenths of three part materials whose unit is that part of one whole source unit, derived from the hazelnut row and the composition: hazelnut-loose-kernel (0.08 kg per unit, all of the unit's nutrition 18 and toxicity 0, the same decay lifetime, a food record of unprocessed hazelnut), hazelnut-casing-fragments (0.12 kg, no food value, no decay) and hazelnut-cracked-mixed (the whole opened unit, unseparated); each block therefore partitions exactly, and a finer internal ledger in tenths and kg records input, untouched, closed, mixed, kernel, fragments, casing debris (always 0: fragments are counted whole) and striker and support wear, and must balance. Products are owned, separately addressable, merged per job, and carry the source origin, the earliest harvest and the oldest decay of their parts plus a record of the job, the parent item, the part and certified false; nothing is washed, heated, made safe or eaten. Wear (deterministic, scratchStroke rules): a striker no harder than the casing sheds one 0.0001 kg quantum per impact; after a fracture the striker following through onto the support sheds one if it is no harder than the support, while a support softer by 0.5 than the casing or the striker is marked by one; the quantum is debited from the item's physical solids and recorded on the item (stone on the equally hard rock loses 0.0001 kg per fracture, 0.0009 kg for Kai's nine blocks); an object support's mass is not represented, so its marks are ledger-only; the striker never fractures because the passed load never exceeds its own strength; no tool life is invented. Lifecycle: a round without a paid phase pauses the work between phases at no charge; the same action or resume continues it after rechecks and emits a resumed event; cancel releases surviving reserved material once to the owner as it now is and keeps products, fractures, spent energy and wear; death ends the work and leaves reserved material at the worksite while products follow the ordinary death rules; reserved material that spoils ends the work and returns the rest; nothing runs autonomously and paused material keeps ageing. Events (view metadata only, no visual components): casing-cracking-quoted, -started, -impact, -unchanged, -damaged, -fractured, -tool-wear, -separated, -products, -completed, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled and -failed, each with operation, plan and phase, actor, target, striker and support references, position, progress and product items and quantities, and for phases the affected 0.1, prior and resulting casing state, crack value and an evidence id; a closed block never shows contents, no event shows a pose unless a phase was performed, and no badge, nutrition or safety icon appears. Personal records use openRemember keyed by material, striker and support materials and outcome, so the first fracture and first separation are new verified information and identical repeats are not; those information events carry this interface, not probe, and the completion event has no qualified flag, so no satisfaction, practice milestone or reward results. Base rules on products: eat, give and drop take whole units (integer quantity of at least 1), so Kai's 0.9 kernel and 0.9 fragment items can be neither eaten, handed over nor dropped; a whole unit of loose kernel, were one held, is eaten under the existing food rules with exactly one hazelnut unit's nutrition. Assumptions: owned items are carried, so the target and striker are at the worker and the 0.65 m reach applies to the support; the engine quantum of 0.1 unit is the block; the hazelnut kernel is wholly accessible once its casing fractures (ex20 composition), so for hazelnut the only damaged mixed material is opened blocks not yet separated; the kernel keeps the hazelnut row's other properties as in ex20; merged lots keep the oldest decay; the operation needs no light, and in the dark the kernel's condition is reported as not seen; one mass quantum per abrasive contact; travel, acquiring a striker and study are separate existing actions. Kai can now study it (3 rounds), walk to start-1-stone, gather one stone with the existing gather action, quote the job, and crack and separate item-16-kai-161 on the rock in 18 rounds for 13.5 energy into 0.9 loose kernel and 0.9 casing fragments; a throwaway check on the archived round-18 world did exactly that (study, navigate, gather, quote, 18 rounds with energy falling by exactly 13.5, stone mass 1.9991 kg, job completed) and was then deleted. Narrowed: the rooted-plant-watering test's assertion that its package is the last one of this experiment now checks that it is the first, and its byte-identity check now covers the packages registered before it. Checks: pnpm typecheck, eslint with no warnings and prettier on the changed files, and 18 test files with 180 tests (this test, the two long-run scenario tests and every test of experiments 19 to 23) passed.
